author: Blairsville GA Daily Brief
title: 🐶 Gentle Blairsville Dogs Ready Now for Loving Adoption
text:
7 hours ago Blairsville has some wonderful dogs hoping for a fresh start. Here are a few sweet pups at Castoff Pet Rescue who are ready to meet you.
Sassy Breed: Fox Terrier (Wirehaired) mix Age: Adult Gender: Female Color: Brown/Chocolate/White Adoption fee: $600 Shelter: Castoff Pet Rescue – (706) 781-3992 Sassy is an adult wirehaired Fox Terrier mix with a striking brown, chocolate, and white coat. She’s waiting at Castoff Pet Rescue for a family who will give her a safe, loving home and the time she deserves. Her adoption fee helps cover her care and vetting.
👉 Meet Sassy and apply to adopt on adoptapet
Penny Breed: Mixed Breed (Medium) / Boston Terrier Age: 4 years (Adult) Gender: Female Weight: 38 lbs Color: Black/White Personality: Adventurous, affectionate, cuddly, energetic, smart, friendly, loyal Great for: Apartment living with daily exercise Adoption fee: $400 Shelter: Castoff Pet Rescue – (706) 781-3992 Penny is a 38‑lb mixed breed/Boston Terrier girl who loves adventure and cuddle time in equal measure. She’s smart, loyal, and wants to be right by your side. Penny can do well in an apartment as long as she gets her walks and playtime.
👉 Meet Penny and apply to adopt on adoptapet
